author: China Insights
description:
Unemployed at 35? Hangzhou couple goes from a million a year to 2,000 a month selling on the street and selling their house! The truth in the documentary "We Who Are Not Young Enough": Why do young people fight to take civil service exams, but middle-aged people have no way out? Behind the 35-year-old curse, is society throwing us all away as a group?

China Insights delivers sharp, data-driven analysis of China’s politics, economy, and society.
We connect the dots behind breaking headlines — from Beijing’s power shifts to global market trends — helping viewers understand the real forces shaping modern China.
Stay informed. Stay ahead.
title: Behind the 35-year-old curse, is society throwing us all away as a group?
